## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight shorts/jeans
- Swimwear
- Towels
- Quick-dry clothes
- Hoodie/sweater for cooler evenings
- Rain jacket

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Beach towel
- Shampoo/conditioner
- Toothbrush/toothpaste
- Travel-sized deodorant
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent

### Electronics
- Smartphone charger
- Travel adapter
- Portable power bank
- Camera

### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents (passport, tickets)
- Snorkel mask
- Flip-flops
- Water bottle
- Guidebook/map
